about: A while checked before each pass cannot read its own body, which has no value before the first pass (#1507, item 4; chapter 4 § 4.3.1, § 4.3.3). The while refine drafts a summary while judge still has something to say. Invalid: it declares checkFirst true, and its check reads node.judge. Valid: checkFirst false, the check run after each pass.
sentences: While 'refine' declares checkFirst true, but its check reads node 'judge' of its own body, which has no value before the first pass: declare "checkFirst": false, or read something that runs before the while.
